notes: Resetting a widget to its defaults no longer changes its size. This was the last of four places that pushed a self-sizing widget through the minimum-size rules meant for panels you size yourself — the other three were fixed in 1.1.242…

Added a standing test for where a panel lands when you send it to another monitor. This had been reported wrong four times with four different symptoms, and each round was worked out by hand against a three-screen setup with mixed display…
Also included: the weather service built alongside this, with its own tests.
